description: Each app's starter protection: the SecureNow rules every app gets when it first sends traffic (SQL injection, XSS, traversal, command and template injection, Log4Shell, metadata SSRF, secret and backup probes, exploit kits, attack-tool user agents, body payloads, failed sign-ins, 404 scanning). Shows the mode (monitor: rules alert only; block: block-ready rules block the address for 6 hours), each rule, alerts in the last 7 days, false positives people marked, and whether the app is ready to block (a week of monitoring without a false positive). Only a person turns blocking on, on the dashboard or with `securenow protect block`.

app.description: Optional application key; every app the caller can see when left out.

title: Starter Protection Status
